name: Cala
description: Cala is the knowledge layer for AI agents: it transforms noisy web information into structured, verified, and traceable data that models can use deterministically. Instead of returning links and raw snippets, Cala provides typed entities, clean query results, and source-backed answers that are ready for programmatic workflows. It supports natural-language and structured outputs, entity discovery and retrieval, and integrates through MCP so tools like Cursor and other agent frameworks can call it directly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cala to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cala to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cala.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cala MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cala provides these MCP tools: entity_introspection, entity_search, knowledge_query, knowledge_search, and retrieve_entity.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cala?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cala in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Cala requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cala is developed by Cala. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
